notes.title: Act 2 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, everybody! Goba here.[/p][p][/p][p]We are coming up on the one year anniversary of release. How harrowing![/p][p][/p][p]That being said, great progress has been made on Act 2, and I'd like to share some of it with you. The first dungeon of Act 2 is nearing completion, sporting a beautiful new visual style. As well, the new cutscenes are looking better than ever. Take a look![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/e80704cf24a074dfffae4c5b1b211a127079c5c5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/a9f5d766c425e3dad29c94325de6e8cc7d35932d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/55376f4b2b7c4a92a3fa4df64c4416fd124887a8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/9aa3d6fc090a016a7087b8c6e3cc7986abc75257.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/df3bfef3a556ad3ff7d360367a583af2de66f222.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/5b970df0e90a98159da141866c120937ef694a26.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/b1b771edfd39b4cc8747ce462569550a8446fc9e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/384a2154b27e730846963551a6b210e8abbaaa27.png"][/img][/carousel][p]The Temple of the Lost Faith is the first dungeon of Act 2: an ancient, pre-Phyllubian religious site taken over by Helix operatives. It is your first stop on the way to Iridopolis, the Elven capital. The dungeon is gorgeous, with secrets to find and new enemies to encounter. I'm confident you'll love it![/p][p][/p][p]I am hoping to share more in the coming months. Thank you all for your patience! I do not yet have a concrete release date, but if I had to put a percentage on it, I would say Act 2 is roughly 30% complete. [/p]

notes.title: Camera, Combat, and Settings Rework!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! It's been an eventful month. As I'm working on Act 2, there's been a lot of little changes that have accumulated to the point where it felt right to release a new version of Act 1 to keep the game in a good, refreshed state for as long as possible.

What are the changes? Let me show you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/df1a60de8bc3dbcc82ac1691d9396d3f3a09083c.png[/img]

The settings menu has been completely overhauled, both internally (making it far easier to add new settings) and externally (making it easier to navigate on controller and KB&M).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/b8b8c7c2d794e9180a875a907685e4f10f6c6607.gif[/img]

The combat camera has been reworked from the ground up, bringing it far closer to what I initially intended. There may be some regressions in its behavior, but overall it provides a much better base to build off of than what existed prior. The camera automatically rotates to frame the closest group of enemies, with [b]customizable tightness[/b] allowing you to adjust it to your personal preferences.

For those who preferred the old camera, a camera deadzone set all the way to the left will give you a close approximation of the old behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/ee2f7bff7fc1881fab572656bbf32f3b75c25771.gif[/img]

No more dropped comboes! Most attacks now magnetize within a certain distance, allowing much smoother combo potential, especially for moves like the Magic Book's dive kick. Give it a try and let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/1dc5623e685374d0c9a611cd020aca196bf0cf04.gif[/img]

The aiming reticle on the Yoobow no longer snaps instantly, but rather smoothly tracks to your desired location over time. This change is purely visual and will not affect gameplay.

Some other miscellaneous changes include:

[list]
[*] Improved mouse functionality in some menus
[*] Added sounds to some menus
[*] Fixed a bug with the Artist's revenge ability making him constantly block attacks
[*] Gave the Artist more health
[*] Changed the soundscape of some cutscenes in the Constructive Criticism side quest
[*] Upgraded the pathfinding package used for Carter's Quest. This should result in better, more performant pathfinding
[*] Performed significant optimizations in the open world, these may lead to new bugs in some instances but I have personally found nothing
[*] Minor change to the first cutscene
[*] Difficulty select window now appears faster and no longer lasts into the first cutscene
[*] Settings are now a file (settings.json) in your save location, and can be edited by hand if necessary
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes, the game audio will stop working and the game will stop rendering. I could only replicate this once and then never again. A restart or clearing of your settings file should fix this issue, but I am working on diagnosing the issue. If it happens to you, please send your log file to me!!
[*] The camera will occasionally point the wrong way at the beginning of an encounter, and then rotate rapidly to the correct position
[/list]

As some of you may know, I recently picked up a second job. This will partially impact the development speed of Carter's Quest, but I am working diligently to make Act 2 the best it can be. The target date for release is still in 2025, but if it does slip away, I will be sure to keep the community updated on the situation. I am eternally grateful for all of the support I've received over the past 8 months and I am excited for you to finally see what I've been cooking up.

Have a great day, and until next time,
Goba!

notes.title: Act 2 Check-in
notes.content:
Hello everybody, Goba here!

As you know from the credits, Act 2 is scheduled for release this year. As of now, I am on-schedule and things are going as planned. New mechanics and new features are already implemented, with more on the way.

So, how are things going? Without ruining the surprise, here are a few screenshots of what I've been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/5c597616a6e57c39544424f197347581207c497c.jpg[/img]
One of the new dungeons, code named "Cathedral," is home to some of the most interesting and innovative gameplay Carter's Quest has yet seen. An old Wizard's temple, pre-Phyllubis, that holds secrets lost to time in the age of Homunculi. Most of all, however, it seems to hold new truths about people we've already met.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/f722390b15f185939b2cf59e21e028d55ccc17c5.jpg[/img]
A new, highly-optimized crowd system, fit for the huge population density of the Elven capital of Iridopolis. In stress-testing, over 1000 characters have been able to appear on screen without breaking a sweat. This feature is in active development, but even early work has bore tastier fruit than I could have ever expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/e4718fe25c50782afff84f92fc661d87fdce412d.jpg[/img]
New enemies have already been created, with many more still waiting to be made. Emphasis is being placed on creating enemies that lend new textures to fights, forcing you to make more decisions in combat than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/be8f4a5de333dae602b7eacaa06a7fcbcf1be2f5.gif[/img]
New storytelling possibilities have been unlocked with the new "bumper" system, that allows characters to interject seamlessly into gameplay. No more cutscenes taking control away for simple worldbuilding details!

All visuals are subject to change and refinement. Only a month into development and Act 2 is already shaping into an interesting experience. What I've shown you represents only a fraction of the work done, and let me just say on behalf of everyone who's seen it, you are going to be delighted by what's coming.

Thank you, everyone! Keep an eye out for new details coming later this year!

- Goba

notes.title: Winter Content Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I hope the holidays have treated you well! If you've been following me on my social media, you'll have noticed I've been working on a new content update. It was intended for Christmas day, but unfortunately-timed illness pushed it back a few days. Oh, the horror!

This update comes bearing two decent gifts! Two mini-dungeons, in fact!

A mysterious artist has appeared in Kaliere Commune! His work has the ability to transport you to another world... [b]literally![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/e2d14aa58aa687f2bf2026433019d5109d2b78af.png[/img]

You can find him in the now-appropriately labeled Arts building in the middle of the market. Speak with him to begin the new [b]Constructive Criticism[/b] quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/5c6b4d0b2e872df7536a43fab19bb7554c0f187e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/7085c132aafd290a9d4398cfcf5e422c4eb84934.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/9e004c876c3f26abac9758c00fb7d54bfa0fd0ee.png[/img]

Rewards for completing this mini-dungeon are meaty! A whole new weapon paired with a whole new costume! How's that for a Christmas gift?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/802b412b75a45bf8888ec39445e3fdb8dfde7797.png[/img]

Alongside that, the basement of the Observatory has been opened! A wizard has gone missing in that musty old place... Surely nothing weird is afoot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/f2cc6c029dbca5484eaace2c75337c5e61592ef2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/57498747c02ad16a38e4ae90e54324b80c2366f8.png[/img]

Along with the new content additions, this update lands a few fixes and changes to existing systems.

Thank you all for the support, and onward to Act 2! Happy holidays and to an even happier new year! Yippee!!

Full changelog:

[list]
[*] Air combos now properly increment the internal air combo counter, so infinite aerial spam is less possible
[*] Carter disappearing in certain cutscenes and the associated softlocks are now fixed beyond a reasonable doubt (This fix seems to appear in every patch, but mark my words this is the one!!)
[*] Added the Constructive Criticism quest
[*] Added the Magic Paint Brush weapon
[*] Added the Artist costume
[*] Added a generalized "revenge" system for enemies, to avoid infinite combos. No Act 1 enemies have been changed, but expect future enemies to take advantage of this.
[*] Fixed a hardlock in the Frogon Fighting minigame
[/list]

notes.title: Carter's Quest Launch²
notes.content:
The largest content update so far has just arrived!

Launch² is a comprehensive reworking of the awkward middle half of Act 1, with new mechanics, cutscenes, and dungeons in tow. Follow Carter's journey to learn the secrets of magic, gaining new abilities along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/725a5ae5a2049bf2c4d95a0b2c8b638831bc2e5b.png[/img]

Kaliere Commune has received a total facelift, adding not just new NPC schedules and interactions, but fundamentally changing how you navigate around and relate to the space itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/94da2c19fa60eff2728bc566dc891abe2b643225.gif[/img]

Spells have been introduced into the mix, one-off abilities that increase the options you have on the battlefield. I was always dissatisfied with the lack of options to control space in combat, and I'm happy to say you now have a plethora of options at your disposal, with more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/63611e4ada34564c95e102a2ffad061ff7ded51d.gif[/img]

The character of Jalysus has gotten the most love out of anyone. At launch, he was a very simple character without much depth. We spent very little time with him, as the meat and bones of his character were originally planned to come much later down the line. Now, his role in Act 1 has been recast as a mentor figure; not just to Carter, in his quest to learn more about wizardry, but to an entire generation of wizards as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/524fc82e3ee1f094802af89db6ba2347540515bd.png[/img]

The motivations and backstory of the Helix have gotten far more attention. Learn more about their plans and what was happening behind the scenes before the epic moments at the end of Act 1. Who really are these allies of Elys?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/4da1838d215f45f4f028fa794f17cec8d46f6d58.png[/img]

No more running to a potion fountain or the Kaliere General Store! You can now craft potions on the fly. This mechanic is very exciting to me, so expect far more potions in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/2dc600a56408b3306096d179883f1f6f28493e30.gif[/img]

In addition to all of that, new enemies have arrived. See how many you can find!

[i]NOTE TO RETURNING PLAYERS: As a result of the major structural changes, your old save files may work but are unsupported. Please, enjoy the new Chapter Select feature if you would like to skip to the new content. All efforts have been made to ensure this never happens again.[/i]

Now, for the more exhaustive changelog:

Gameplay
[list]
[*] The broom has been overhauled to control more in line with expectations
[*] Carter now always dodges in the direction you're holding, irrespective his current direction
[*] Spells have been added, launched by using LB on the controller after unlocking them
[/list]
Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Addressed Moth Urgum instantly snapping into the air
[*] Enemies no longer perfectly track your movement
[*] You can no longer softlock the Wizard's College by backtracking
[*] King Lanky and Helix Monstrosity can now be hit by any weapon
[*] The camera no longer flies out of control during dense scenes, such as the "war" scene
[*] The broom and broadsword now correctly center during their "item get" cutscenes
[*] Fixed the wildly inconsistent sound design of Moth Urgum
[*] Fixed trees not colliding in the open world (this was the result of an optimization gone wrong)
[*] Targeting Ryval now looks correct
[*] Ocean water no longer becomes bright blue randomly
[*] Yolanda is now pregnant, rather than referring to a toddler that does not exist (O.o)
[*] Townies performing activities or poses no longer fail to look at you, and no longer snap out of their pose for a frame
[/list]
Improvements
[list]
[*] New library art by the amazing [url=https://bsky.app/profile/toc.bsky.social]Caim Luna[/url]!
[*] New music by the wonderful [url=https://bsky.app/profile/deadi.bsky.social]DEADi[/url]!
[*] Cutscene skipping is no longer a hidden feature
[*] The UI now has a more consistent control scheme
[*] Multiple save files are now supported, as well as in-game deletion
[*] Introduced a chapter select, which currently allows you to skip the old Wizard's College portion
[*] Added a quest log in the KellyPhone, which allows you to keep track of your objectives
[*] Added sound design to almost every interactive element in the game, and improved existing sound design in most cutscenes and for most behaviors
[*] The ally to enemy composition of the "war" scene has been altered for better gameplay
[*] Roaming enemy squads now spawn at night time
[*] Elys now has more attacks and is more resistant to being comboed
[/list]
Kaliere
[list]
[*] Kaliere Commune has been remodeled
[*] The Kaliere General Store has been relocated
[*] New costumes have been added to Devira's Fashion Shop
[*] The New Wizard's College has been remodeled and repositioned, now towering over Kaliere Commune
[*] Two new shops have been added: The All-Wizard's Magic Shop and a store for potion reagents
[*] New props dot the landscape, some of which NPCs will autonomously interact with and use.
[*] Empty or otherwise pointless interiors have been closed off. Every enterable interior has something meaningful inside
[*] More guards have been added to defend the streets
[/list]
Old Wizard's College
[list]
[*] Gear puzzles have been given sound design
[*] Minor cutscene changes and additions
[*] A new enemy encounter has been added
[*] Bugs with allied Elys battles have been fixed
[/list]
Shooma
[list]
[*] More mushrooms have been added to improve the atmosphere
[/list]

Unfortunately, there are a few [b]known issues[/b] I am aware of
[list]
[*] All projectile systems have a bug recovering launched projectiles, this results in janky behavior in the flight sequence most particularly (not gamebreaking)
[*] Multi-scene cutscenes still have a minor 'hitch' where you can see the scene loading and initializing before fading into the cutscene. This will be fixed but requires touching too many systems to feel safe it will perform well in all scenarios
[*] Cutscene skipping does not work if a dialogue is open or about to become open
[*] The behavior of townies in Kaliere Commune is still slightly inconsistent and will likely receive further work in the future
[*] Certain UI elements are very hard to properly hover over with mouse and keyboard
[*] The timestamp in the KellyPhone does not properly reflect ingame state
[*] Spells still play some sound effects even when you're out of mana
[*] Drinking out of health fountains does not play a sound effect
[*] Interrupting Helix Melee-type enemies while they initiate their rock throw attack does not destroy the rock
[/list]

In addition to the hour+ of new content, there is some side content that was cut for time. Expect even more spells, cutscenes, and dungeons in December! I will be working diligently over the next few weeks to give you even more stories from the world of Web!

Criticisms from the community directly led the efforts to expand the story and improve the gameplay. This wouldn't have happened without the amazing response the game got. I am truly humbled by the support I have received and I hope these additions stand the test of time.

To new and returning players, please enjoy this, and bare with me as we begin the long and difficult path to shipping Act 2!

notes.title: Act 1 Rework is coming soon!
notes.content:
Major changes are coming to the world of Web next month! In an effort to make Act 1 as good as it can be as we enter the long haul towards Act 2, I am working on new content and quality-of-life features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/63611e4ada34564c95e102a2ffad061ff7ded51d.gif[/img]

As this update will touch huge portions of the game, I am dubbing it "Launch 2.0," to signify it as a rebirth of the core Carter's Quest experience.

Here's a taste of what you have to look forward to when Launch 2.0 drops next month:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The user interface has been updated to be easier to navigate and prettier to look at
[*] No more saving woes! Multiple save files will now be supported within the main menu
[*] Boss battles have been improved with reworked sound design and new moves
[*] Bug fixes across the entire game
[*] Kaliere Commune has been remodeled, focusing primarily on the Eastern half of the city
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/2dc600a56408b3306096d179883f1f6f28493e30.gif[/img]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Substantial new story content (estimated 40 minutes of playtime) that follow Carter's journey gaining the trust of Jalysus
[*] New music tracks
[*] New dungeons, optional and otherwise
[*] New enemies, including the formidable Giant Rat Imp, placed into new and existing areas
[*] Spells, a new form of utility attack that can be strung into your combos for additional sauce
[*] Alchemy, craft potions with those hordes of useless items in your inventory
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/94da2c19fa60eff2728bc566dc891abe2b643225.gif[/img]

Many of these ideas were planned for Act 2, but after getting some constructive criticism vis a vis the pacing issues in the latter half of Act 1, I thought pulling them forward would give the characters more time to breathe. This update is still very much in development, so look out on my social media channels to see the new content as it comes in.

Thank you all so much for the amazing reception so far! To more great times!

- Goba

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/c639399405c721ee81a40d6e889c5755792a90fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/4da1838d215f45f4f028fa794f17cec8d46f6d58.png[/img]

[h3]Work in progress, subject to change.[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 2 - Frogon Fighting and More!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MJXNIoXMHzU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

A new minigame has come to Web! Go to the waterfall and speak to the Games Goblin to experience his new challenge: Frogon Fighting! The reward will be quite interesting to fans of action games.

Other changes include some new sound effects in cutscenes that didn't have them prior, and some minor fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed additional bottle given to the player at the start of the game (sorry!)
[*] Added additional error checking to saving player data. If you receive an error after saving, report it as soon as possible to any means of communication.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1 - Major QOL fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added feedback to the save button
[*] Major changes to the combat camera
[*] Fixed a softlock if the player returns underground after leaving during a cutscene
[*] Fix to the Heart softlock issue
[*] Added all of the dialogue for the KellyPhone
[*] More rumors at The Drunken Moon
[*] Health potions now automatically equip to your quick select if you have an empty bottle equipped
[*] Baked occlusion culling for the open world, let me know ASAP if you see any graphical or physics bugs
[*] Fixed sound issues in the Urgum fight (Let me know if I missed anything)
[*] Fixed the extremely loud sounds in the Kelly-Ryval fight scene
[/list]
